items.heading: Every Route Can Look Good
items.text: Every route can look good in a brochure. The Three-Number Check strips it down to three questions you can answer with a pencil. Run it on each route you are thinking about.

items.heading: The Order Below Follows Growth,
items.text: The order below follows growth, not prestige. Skills you can sell directly lead, because you control the price and the pace. Routes that depend on beating many rivals at stage after stage come last, and they stay on the list with their risk written beside them.

figures.label: Education Budget
figures.source: A worked example, not a rule: if your family can put Rs 10 lakh into your whole education, start with about Rs 1 lakh for one more credential. The other Rs 9 lakh protects your living costs and pays for the skills and projects that build a portfolio. If one course asks for more than about Rs 2 lakh, it needs the proof listed above.
